facts.fact: 春天：毒蘑菇清除后草场重新开花。
facts.anchor: Flowers have taken over where the mushrooms used to be.

facts.fact: 国王倒台后全镇上山清蘑菇，历时数周。
facts.anchor: Everyone pitched in to remove every last mushroom from the mountain.

facts.fact: 畸形幼龙群多已装上定做义翅。
facts.anchor: Most of them wear prosthetics—each one custom built to fit them.

facts.fact: 哨声后 Maple 飞回扑倒两人。
facts.anchor: Maple comes soaring over the trees

facts.fact: 放归数月，Maple 已融入龙群会猎会玩。
facts.anchor: It was difficult to release her months ago, but we both knew it was the right thing to do.
But Micah and I will always be here.

facts.fact: Lucan 搬进 Micah 小屋，楼上公寓出租；上班同行。
facts.anchor: Now that I’ve moved into Micah’s cottage
a large piece of raw gold. It wasn’t cheap
I begin crafting the most important piece of metal I’ve ever forged…

facts.fact: 尾声揭晓：求婚戒指；The End。
